create_function_merge: create a function that merges two DataFrames using SQL-style inner, left, right, outer, cross, or anti joins on columns or indexes
create_function_merge_ordered: create a function that performs an ordered merge with optional forward-fill interpolation on sorted time-series DataFrames
create_function_merge_asof: create a function that merges two DataFrames by nearest key distance with backward, forward, or nearest direction and optional tolerance
build_class_MergeOperation: build the _MergeOperation class that executes database-style merge operations between two DataFrames using column or index keys
test_function_get_join_indexers: test the get_join_indexers function that returns left and right join indexers for hash-based or sorted merges
